title: Eventual lifting on one specified affine chart
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a ring functor and $c$ a limit cone of its opposite Spec diagram with affine vertex. Fix $i\le j$ and a scheme morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let $F_j,G_j$ be finitely presented quasi-coherent modules on $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}R_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\varphi$ be a map of their tensor pullbacks to $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}c.pt$. Supply an arbitrary open cover $U_j$ of $X_j$ and one index $a$ such that its chart $U_j.X(a)$ is affine. There exists $k\ge j$ such that for every $l\ge j,k$ the selected chart of the pulled-back cover on $X_l$ admits a map between the restrictions of the tensor pullbacks of $F_j,G_j$ whose further pullback equals the restriction of $\varphi$, transported by the canonical tensor composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] and restriction/tensor pullback comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]. Only this one chart has a lift asserted. No finite cover, common stage for multiple charts or overlap equation is asserted. No Noetherianity or finiteness assumption on $f$ is imposed.

proof.text: Apply finitePresentation_one_chart_map_lift_at_stage to the chosen affine chart, obtaining k≥j and rk with its recovery equation. This is only a lift at k.

Apply openCover_map_lift_transport to R, c, the fixed models Fj,Gj, the chart Uj(a), and the supplied index k≥j and its one-stage recovery assertion. This transports the supplied lift to each later index l≥j,k. The input theorem requires neither directedness nor the limit property nor finiteness, because these are used only to obtain k in the first step. The Lean proof combines the existential stage choice and this universal persistence assertion, with every tensor/restriction comparison exactly as in the unchanged original statement.
